title: Favorite clarinetists: Noone, Dodds, Tio and Big Eye
summary: He names Jimmy Noone, Johnny Dodds, Lorenzo Tio and Big Eye as favorites and praises Tio's clean playing.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
